# Vetta 0.6.13
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-20 -->

## English

### New

- Plugins can now use the host's own controls: platform-correct keycaps, − / + steppers for numbers with limits, and a color picker that samples the screen or takes pasted values, all matching Settings.

### Improvements

- Settings → Appearance → Chat colors: swatches replace the dropdown, so the current color is visible at a glance. The last swatch opens a picker with screen sampling, hue/lightness dragging and pasted values; light bubbles use dark text.
- Settings → Shortcuts now shows one raised keycap per key, matching the keyboard preview in app snapshots: ⌘ ⌥ ⇧ on macOS, Ctrl / Alt / Shift on Windows. Recording and resetting work as before.
- The shortcut hints at the bottom of the sidebar workspace list use the same keycaps as Settings.
- Release notes in the update dialog are now bilingual and show only the language you use.

## 中文

### 新增

- 插件可以使用宿主的界面部件：快捷键用宿主键帽（macOS 显示 ⌘ ⌥，Windows 显示 Ctrl），数值用带上下限的 − / + 步进器，配色用可用吸管取色的色点选择器。

### 改进

- 设置 → 外观 → 聊天外观：气泡颜色从下拉列表改成一排色点，当前颜色一眼可见。最后一枚可以自选，支持拖明度与色相、吸屏取色、粘贴色值；浅色气泡自动配深色文字。
- 设置 → 快捷键改为一键一枚的浮雕键帽，与「应用快照」的键盘预览同一质感：macOS 显示 ⌘ ⌥ ⇧，Windows 显示 Ctrl / Alt / Shift，录制行为不变。
- 侧边栏底部工作空间列表里的快捷键提示换成同一套键帽，不再与设置页两种观感。
- 更新对话框里的版本说明改为中英双语，按界面语言只显示对应的一段。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.12...v0.6.13
